26622191.title: A pharmacogenomic prospective randomized controlled trial of CYP2B6 polymorphisms and efavirenz dose adjustment among HIV-infected Thai patients: a pilot study.
26622191.timing: CYP2B6 genotyping was assigned before the initial antiretroviral dose.
26622191.reported_result: The poor-metabolizer participant receiving 400 mg/day had a lower mean efavirenz concentration than the poor-metabolizer participant receiving 600 mg/day (1.916 versus 3.915 micrograms/mL).

17918089.title: Successful efavirenz dose reduction in HIV type 1-infected individuals with cytochrome P450 2B6 *6 and *26.
17918089.timing: Five efavirenz-naive CYP2B6 *6/*6 or *6/*26 carriers began efavirenz at 400 mg/day.
17918089.monitored_adjustment: Two of the five still had high efavirenz concentrations at 400 mg/day and were reduced to 200 mg/day.
17918089.reported_result: The two participants reduced from an initial 400 mg/day to 200 mg/day retained HIV-1 suppression.
